gate_semantics: Only assess the explicitly registered domain and intended sleeve. Never apply total-portfolio20percent annual return to each module. Positive but sparse modules remain unqualified research candidates; zero opportunities are unknown. Risk and financial integrity still required.
target_construction: At each existing hourly decision row, copy the frozen family targets only when its already available daily state is in the card's allowed_states; otherwise request zero targets. Preserve clock/risk_scale, factor amplitude, previous normalization and net inventory until actual exits. No new forecast fitting, threshold optimization or target renormalization.
selection_before_later_diagnostics: After two-cost2025screen, take at most3research followups by positive both-cost closed+marked PnL, then minimum both-cost complete-cycle count, then worst-cost expectancy, then lexical ID. Research followup is not admission. Modules with economic loss and no new failure explanation do not trigger parameter grids. Freeze list before later-account computation; never use2026ranking.
capacity_scope: Report tested sleeve capital/mean and peak utilization/hedge failures; a module need only support its intended allocation. Combined100kportfolio capacity must later be verified on shared orders, not inferred by adding individual capacities.
module_correlation: Compare actual daily net PnL, downside and overlap at contemporaneous opportunity clocks. Different names or parameter values are not independent mechanisms.
portfolio_next: Only after at least2mechanisms have sufficient module evidence, preregister static diversified, past-risk-scaled and bounded-state-tilt common-account allocations plus ablations. Otherwise continue research or remain cash; do not manufacture a multi-strategy result.
interpretation: These cards are formulated after viewing prior history. Registration precedes only the next calculations; it does not restore untouched OOS. Broad BTC state is a coarse observable proxy, not proof each asset shares that regime.
implementation_clarifications: Missing full-family controls are generated only in diagnostic windows. Capacity comparisons use already frozen static trend and actual cash controls; missing own-family capacity is left unavailable.
All high-cost2025module accounts verify real JSON continuation at first entry or a fixed flat boundary; selection uses only registered two-cost2025metrics.
Trend, relative momentum and breakout are not automatically independent mechanisms. Funding-plus-momentum requires a same-opportunity funding-term ablation before claiming separate funding alpha.
